verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that `fly launch` creates, configures, and deploys an app from the project directory (fly-io-docs-16, fly-io-docs-1). That implies some generated configuration, but the pack never names a declarative config file or shows that one file can describe multiple apps, databases, volumes, or regions. Missing for 10: a documented single config file format, defining the whole multi-service architecture (apps, Postgres, volumes, regions) in that file, versioning or rollback of the config, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
